overview:
**Fire danger is rated High today, driven by low humidity (27%) and elevated energy release (ERC 74%) despite calm NE winds.**
- Danger stays High through Monday before easing to Moderate on Sept 8 as humidity recovers.
- Warm, dry, breezy NE winds (9 mph) and afternoon temps near 69°F are the main drivers; no rain expected until midweek.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warning is active per NWS.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM lands across Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, Saguache, and San Juan counties, with Gunnison and Hinsdale counties under stricter Stage 2 restrictions banning all outdoor fires.
- The Elk Fire, 7 miles northwest of Lake City in Hinsdale County, is holding at 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with minimal fire behavior reported today.
